caption:
Hybi's weekly recap for Apr 12–15, with this week's comics in one place.

Prop your tablet on a cushion or stand and change position every 20–30 minutes. Putting on a jacket with a sore shoulder, try the sore arm first into the sleeve. Setting the change table to about waist height can ease the strain on your back. At a call centre, keep the screen at eye level and stand up briefly every 30 minutes.

Scroll back through the week for the full comics. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios, chiropractors and remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio
